name: TryAMM 2026 Sustainable Pricing
principle: Subscriptions pay for access, workflow and included allowances; expensive AI/video/3D/holographic/broadcast/storage work is metered so every job covers variable cost, payment fees, reserves, support and target profit.

plans.name: Discover
plans.targetUser: shoppers, learners, fans and light creators

plans.name: Creator
features: HoloMarket selling eligibility subject to verification

plans.name: Studio
plans.targetUser: shows, game teams, agencies and virtual production

plans.name: Business / Agency
plans.targetUser: brands, agencies, production companies and creator networks

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.targetUser: schools, broadcasters, large brands, governments and institutions

marketplaceEconomics.note: Use lower negotiated rates for high-volume enterprise sellers and higher disclosed service fees only where additional services justify them.
marketplaceEconomics.paymentProcessing: pass through or absorb only after margin modeling
marketplaceEconomics.licensing: creator-defined prices within minimum fee/margin rules

marginRules.jobRule: estimated direct variable cost + payment fee + reserve + support allocation must be calculated before job authorization; credit debit or price must satisfy configured contribution-margin floor
marginRules.reprice: automatically review pricing when provider costs move materially

competitivePositioning: Do not lead with cheapest credits. Lead with one creator operating system: create, protect, reuse, license, distribute, monetize, learn and build ownership across media, games, HoloVerse, commerce and education.
